Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
Harrod plays maneuver with his magnum...before strike he plays Disguised
Weapon and lets his Ghoul Retainer shoot with it. Is this legal? I'd suppose
so but want to be sure.

Roger

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
LSJ wrote:

> Yes.

To be clear: Harrod strikes with his magnum and the Ghoul Retainer uses
the weapon retrieved with Disguised Weapon.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <tf64eb2...@corp.supernews.com>, Bradly Ward
<br...@jakescrane.com> writes

>Can Harrod play an immortal grapple

Yes (at close range).

He would then be prevented from striking.

>and his retainer still use the weapon to
>shoot?

Yes. IG only affects strikes. The retainer's effect is not a strike.
